تستنكرون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْكِرُونَ (tastankirūna) /tas.tan.ki.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# تُسْتَنْكَرُونَ (tustankarūna) /tus.tan.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
